kultivator.technique.azure_essence_sword: Stance (1 qi/s, 15 to start): while it is held, each sword strike looses a thin crescent (0.6×, 6→12 blocks). From Immortal Ascension three crescents fan out.
Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey · 青元剑诀 Azure Essence Sword Art, Han Li's base sword art (13 layers in the human world; the Great Geng formation needs a high layer)
The azure light rides every stroke of the blade.
3→10 sword shadows seek foes within 20→48 blocks and pierce through them: 0.7× each, at most 3 per foe.
Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey · 剑影分光术, a divine ability of the Azure Essence Sword Art: the sword light splits off duplicate sword shadows
One sword, many shadows; none of them is false.
kultivator.technique.giant_sword_light.d: Charge 0.75 s, then a giant sword light cleaves forward (10→36 blocks, 3 wide): 3.0×, rooted 1 s, lifted.
kultivator.technique.giant_sword_light.s: Source: Inspired by the giant sword light of the Azure Essence Sword Art (A Record of a Mortal's Journey); not a named canon art
kultivator.technique.giant_sword_light.l: The blade grows until the sky looks small.
kultivator.technique.heavenly_wolf_slash: Dash 8→20 blocks (brief invulnerability) slashing everything on the path for 2.2×, then Wild Fang: a 30° cone (10→18 blocks) of 1.2× and Weakness I for 4 s.
Source: Against the Gods · Heavenly Wolf Hell God's Tome: Heavenly Wolf Slash (1st style, ch. 148) and Wild Fang (2nd style, ch. 1297)
First the slash, then the fang.
kultivator.technique.bloodmoon_immortal_: After 1 s a blood-moon sword rain falls on the aimed area (radius 8→16, 12→36 swords over 2 s, 0.9× each); then a final strike of 3.0× in radius 4 leaves foes 20% more vulnerable to Sword arts for 10 s.
Source: Against the Gods ch. 1266 · Bloodmoon Immortal Slaying Sword: Xisu's Immortal Slaying Sword Formation, which badly injured two great moon gods
When the moon turns red, the sword rain answers.
kultivator.technique.overlord_fury.desc: Leap to the aimed spot (16→24 blocks) and slam: a shockwave (6→20 blocks) of 3.5× at the centre down to 1.5× at the edge, launching foes and halving their armour for 8 s.
kultivator.technique.overlord_fury.sourc: Source: Against the Gods ch. 333 · 霸王怒 Overlord's Fury, from a fragment of the broken Overlord sword
kultivator.technique.overlord_fury.lore: A broken sword still remembers the overlord.
kultivator.technique.immortal_tribulatio: A white-gold tribulation beam (48→64 blocks) pierces every foe on its line: 4.0× plus qi damage of 0.25×/s for 8 s.
Source: Perfect World ch. 1786/1973 · Immortal Tribulation Sword Art, one of the three great sword extremes (with the Grass Symbol Sword Art and the Chaos Calming Art)
The beam carries the weight of a tribulation.
One stroke of the glyph 草 cuts the 5→8 strongest foes within 32 blocks in sight (calm neutral creatures too): 2.5× and Slowness III for 3 s.
Source: Perfect World ch. 1786 · 草字剑诀 Grass Symbol Sword Art: a single blade of grass that can cut apart sun, moon and stars
A single blade of grass, a single stroke.
kultivator.technique.heavenbreaker_stanc: Charge 2 s (cast again to release early, at least half power): an immense blade front (40→64 blocks, 4 wide, 12 high) of 8.0× × the charge, rooting foes for 2 s and slamming them down.
Source: Desolate Era · Ji Ning's [Heavenbreaker] stance: the sword is made heavier so its weight drives the strike
Weight, not speed, breaks the heavens.
kultivator.technique.lu_ya_gourd.desc: The gourd's thread pins the locked target (within 48 blocks): stunned 3 s (bosses rooted 0.75 s); 3 s later 8.0× and an execute below 35% health (bosses 5%).
kultivator.technique.lu_ya_gourd.source: Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 48 · Lu Ya's gourd: a thread of light and a thing "with eyebrows and eyes" pin Bai Tianjun, "请宝贝转身", and his head falls
kultivator.technique.blood_drop_stance.d: Blink behind the target, then chain 6→12 blinks among foes within 24 blocks; each blink strikes for 3.0×, doubled below half health, and executes below 15%.
kultivator.technique.blood_drop_stance.s: Source: Desolate Era · the Blood Drop stance of the Brightmoon sword art, the fastest, most savage and most penetrating of its five stances
kultivator.technique.astral_sword_intent: A star-sword domain follows you (radius 16→32, 15 s): 1.2× every second; each of your melee or technique hits calls 2 star swords of 0.8× (at most 6 per second).
Source: Desolate Era · Quintessence Sword-Intent, third stance "Astral"
The stars become swords and circle their master.
kultivator.technique.zhuxian_sword_forma: A square formation (side 48→64, walls) for 12 s: 2.0× each second, strips buffs and slows (IV); the corner pillars strike for 4.0× every 2 s; at the end 10.0× to every foe inside and an execute below 15%.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 77–78 · 誅仙陣, Tongtian Jiaozhu's formation with the four swords 誅仙 戮仙 陷仙 絕仙, broken only by the Three Teachings together
Four swords, four laws, one formation.
kultivator.technique.heaven_punishing_sw: Four phases: 3.0× to the 9 strongest within 40 blocks; stun and Darkness for 3 s within 40; 5.0× within 40; then a travelling beam 128 blocks long that passes through blocks, 12.0×.
Source: Against the Gods ch. 2189 · Heaven Punishing Sword Art, tied to Mo E's Heaven Punishing Ancestral Sword (the four-phase structure is game design)
